t.zh: 套用把函数用在证明上；函数则由假设框造出。造函数写作 fun h => …，意思是「拿到 h，就给出 …」：框里假设的那一句名叫 h，框里的证明可以用它，框外得到一个等着 h 的函数。这叫，也写作 λ h => …。
t.en: Apply uses a function on a proof; the function is made by the assumption box. A function is written fun h => …, “given h, give …”: the sentence the box assumes is named h, the proof inside may use it, and outside comes a function waiting for an h. This is , also written λ h => ….

t.zh: 元件上，框里的假设叫 h1，里面一层框的叫 h2。名字只是记号：fun h => h 和 fun x => x 是同一个证明项。
t.en: On the parts, a box’s assumption is h1 and the one of a box inside it h2. Names are only labels: fun h => h and fun x => x are the same term.

after.zh: 真值表只说一句话真不真，证明项还记得它为什么真：同一个类型可以有不同的程序。
after.en: A truth table only says whether a sentence is true; a proof term also remembers why. One type can have different programs.

briefNote.zh: 证明项须为 fun h => p h q。
briefNote.en: Its proof term must be fun h => p h q.

hint.zh: fun h => … 是一个框，h 是框里假设的那一句；箭头后面是框里要接出的东西。
hint.en: fun h => … is a box, h the sentence it assumes; after the arrow is what is wired inside it.

briefNote.zh: 证明项须为 fun a b => a。
briefNote.en: Its proof term must be fun a b => a.

hint.zh: fun a b => … 是 fun a => fun b => … 的简写：两层框，外层假设 a，里层假设 b。
hint.en: fun a b => … is short for fun a => fun b => …: two boxes, the outer assuming a, the inner b.

brief.zh: 还是这一句，证明项须为 fun a b => b。
brief.en: The same sentence, with the term fun a b => b.

hint.zh: 这回要的是里层框的那个假设。
hint.en: This time the one wanted is the inner box’s assumption.
